As the most abundant skin cell type, EpD accounted for 37.96% (9201 cells) of all skin cells, which could be divided into nine different clusters, including three basal cell types (EpD_Basal1–3) majorly expressing basal epithelium markers KRT5, KRT14, ITGA6, and ITGB1; four epithelial differentiated cell types (EpD_Spinous, EpD_Granualr/spinous, EpD_Granular, EpD_Corneum) majorly recognized by epithelial differentiation marker KRT10, KRT1, and GRHL1 (ref. 20 – 23 ); sebaceous gland (EpD_SG) expressing APOC1, ACSL5, ABCC3 (ref. 24 ); follicles (EpD_Foli) expressing CD200, SOX9, KRT19 (ref. 25 , 26 ).
